description: Na₃Li₃Mn₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.60 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.54 Å. There are three inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted LiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MnO₆ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MnO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 68°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.08 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MnO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.11 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.05 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.19 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.32 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, corners with three LiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-63°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, corners with three LiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-53°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLiMnP tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiMnP tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent OLi₂MnP tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing OLi₂MnP tetrahedra. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one C atom to form distorted ONaLi₂C tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent OLi₂MnP tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiMnP tetrahedra.
